args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware): This week's topic is freight pricing this quarter; links to the main article at blog.juniper.example/2026/freight.
- Main article: Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Subscriber companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Juniper Labware Freight Newsletter Summary
